body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Versailles, France. The listing gives its length as 2.5 – 3 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at 5 Av. de Sceaux, Avenue de Sceaux, 5. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Palace of Versailles. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Sergio as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> One of the most famous World Heritage Sites in France – the Palace of Versailles amazes its visitors with incredible scale, splendor, beauty and unrivaled opulence. Once the official residence of the French kings, it is now the museum. Explore the Palace of Versailles and its magnificent Gardens with the help of this private self-guided audio tour.
>
> At first, visit the palace itself. This tour will introduce you to the most iconic parts of the legendary chateau – the State Apartments. Examine the King’s and Queen’s Bedchambers as well as the emblematic Hall of Mirrors. Hear the stories about the events that took place in each of the room and discover incredible art that adorns the palace.
>
> Then, head outside. Admire the masterpiece of Andre Lenotre – the majestic Gardens embellished by incredible fountains and classical statues. Explore the Versailles Orangerie and get to know how all that splendor was created.
>
> Listen to the stories about famous inhabitants of the palace such as Louis XIV and Marie-Antoinette along the way. Discover the history of the chateau and immerse yourself into the life of the French Royal Court in the 18th century.
>
> Note! This tour is not affiliated with the Palace of Versailles but is provided by an independent creator. The ticket is included for the customer's convenience at no additional cost.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €40.16. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 2551 ratings and 995 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
